text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking she would soon be abandoned, 
Meisho Doto tried to leave her Trainer. 
But after being stopped, she decided to 
continue her activities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her body is gradually showing signs of 
entering her peak. At this rate, the Derby 
could be the next goal, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chickening out, she declined with all her 
might. Her body was waking up, but her 
mind wasn't ready yet. She decided to gain 
a bit more racing experience first.
